model.name: diffEditor.repoTargeting
model.description: The diff/file tooling targets a selectable repo (e.g. OOSH) via a server-side key-allowlist: client sends a repo KEY (?repo=oosh), RepoRegistry.resolve maps it to an allowlisted absolute root (else null->400), RepoRegistry.list feeds a repo picker, GitApi de-hardcodes ROOT to the resolved root, and RbFileTree.setRepo reloads the tree for the chosen repo. Default rawbin.
